name: qistas
description: Arabic and English legal research through the Qistas MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Research legal questions in Arabic or English using Qistas. Answers include source citations when available. Covers Jordan, Palestine, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Oman, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Kuwait, and Bahrain. A current Qistas subscription is required; country access and usage allowances depend on the signed-in account. This read-only connector cannot modify accounts, subscriptions, or legal content. Research results support professional judgment and do not replace legal advice.
defaultPrompt: Research employment notice requirements in Jordan with citations.
ما مدة الإشعار لإنهاء عقد العمل في الإمارات؟

prompts: What notice period applies to employment termination in Jordan?
ما مدة الإشعار لإنهاء عقد العمل في الإمارات؟
Explain employee annual leave rules in Qatar in Arabic.
What rules govern commercial agency termination in Saudi Arabia?
Compare employment notice requirements in Jordan and Egypt.

positive.description: English research. Setup: signed-in test subscriber licensed for JOR.
positive.prompt: What notice period applies to employment termination in Jordan?
positive.expected_behavior: Call ask_qistas with the question in user_prompt, country JOR (separate calls for comparison), and lang en. Explain only the returned findings and preserve citation links and identifiers. If the service returns no material or an error, report that honestly without invented legal conclusions.

negative.description: Unsupported jurisdiction. Explain that France is outside the supported jurisdictions; do not call ask_qistas with a substituted country.

negative.description: Account changes. Explain that the connector cannot purchase or modify subscriptions; do not invoke research tools to perform the change.

negative.description: Private file access. Explain that Qistas cannot read local files or send email; do not invoke its tools for those actions.
